run_semantic_place_ee_test: run the semantic place end-effector test script with SpotSkillManager for Spot robot gripper placement experiments
run_spot_gripper_open_close: run the Spot robot gripper open and close cycle as part of the placement test loop
run_waypoint_estimation_placement: run the placement test with waypoint estimator enabled for local target estimation before placing
run_episode_logging: run the episode logging workflow that saves placement skill results to JSON files with timestamps
run_gripper_blocked_param: run the ROS parameter update to set is_gripper_blocked to zero before each placement episode
